2608.30986.title: Controlling Refusal Behavior of LLMs via Stiefel-Constrained Rotation Steering
2608.30986.paper_summary: Activation steering has emerged as a lightweight approach for controlling model refusal at inference time. A growing line of research explores trainable rotations of activations to develop geometrically principled intervention mechanisms. However, existing techniques rely on auxiliary constructs, such as refusal vectors, to define these rotations. In our work, we develop a self-contained methodology for learning parameter-efficient rotational transformations based on Riemannian optimization. We empirically validate the proposed scheme, demonstrating its superiority in intervention efficiency. An extensive ablation study highlights the importance of key design choices in our method. Our results identify the proposed rotation-based steering scheme as a promising direction for more reliable control over the behavior of LLMs.
2608.30986.paper_summary_zh: 啟動引導已成為在推理時控制模型拒絕的一種輕量級方法。越來越多的研究探索可訓練的激活旋轉，以開發幾何原則的干預機制。然而，現有技術依賴於輔助構造，例如拒絕向量，來定義這些旋轉。在我們的工作中，我們開發了一種自包含的方法論，基於黎曼優化學習參數高效的旋轉變換。我們實證驗證了所提出的方案，顯示其在干預效率上的優越性。廣泛的消融研究突顯了我們方法中關鍵設計選擇的重要性。我們的結果將所提出的基於旋轉的引導方案確定為對大型語言模型行為進行更可靠控制的有前景方向。
